items.markdown:
Udon Thani is a major city in the `Isan (northeastern) region of Thailand` . Located approximately 560 km (350 miles) northeast of Bangkok, it serves as the capital of Udon Thani Province and lies just 60 km south of the border with Laos.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Udon_Thani) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Udon_Thani)[[2]](https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/Udon_Thani)

As Thailand's sixth-largest city, Udon Thani is a bustling economic and transit hub known as the gateway to Laos and the Mekong region.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Udon_Thani) [[1]](https://mapy.com/en/?source=osm&id=13685193)

**Getting There & Around:** 

- **Flights:** [Udon Thani International Airport](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Udon_Thani_International_Airport) connects the city to the rest of the country, with multiple daily 50-minute flights to and from Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi and Don Mueang airports.[](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Udon_Thani_International_Airport) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Udon_Thani_International_Airport)[[2]](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Udon_Thani)
- **Trains & Buses:** Daily trains and buses depart regularly from Bangkok's Mochit Bus Terminal and Krung Thep Apiwat Railway Station, taking about 9 hours. You can check schedules and book your journey directly via platforms like [12Go](https://12go.asia/) or [Thailandee.com](https://www.thailandee.com/en/cities/udon-thani).[[1]](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/udon-thani-guide)[[2]](https://www.thailandee.com/en/cities/udon-thani)[[3]](https://12go.asia/en/operator/air-udon)
- **Travel to Laos:** From the city center, you can easily catch trains or buses across the Thai-Lao Friendship Bridge directly into the Laotian capital of Vientiane.[](https://www.adventuresofjellie.com/thailand/udon-thani-guide) 

**Top Things to See and Do:** 

- **Nature:** Relax at the scenic **Nong Prajak Public Park** in the city center, famous for its large lake and outdoor activities.[](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/udon-thani) [[1]](https://uk.hotels.com/go/thailand/udon-thani)
- **History:** Visit the **Ban Chiang Archaeological Site** , a UNESCO World Heritage site showcasing the artifacts of a Bronze Age civilization that dates back more than 5,000 years.[](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Udon-Thani/588) [[1]](https://www.tourismthailand.org/Destinations/Provinces/Udon-Thani/588)[[2]](https://www.hotels.com/go/thailand/udon-thani)
- **Culture:** Explore the **Wat Phothisomphon** temple complex and the **Thai-Chinese Cultural Centre** , offering beautiful traditional gardens and museums.[](https://www.hotels.com/go/thailand/udon-thani)
